## Description {#details}

<p>Base class for all errors indicating malformed binary files.</p>


<p>Having a subclass for all malformed binary files allows archive-walking code to skip malformed files without having to understand every possible way that a binary file might be malformed.</p>


<p>Currently inherits from <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/ecerror">ECError</a> for easy interoperability with std::error_code, but this will be removed in the future.</p>


<p>Definition at line 52 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/object/error-h">Error.h</a>.</p>
